title: Watkins's conjecture holds for all infinite groups
summary: We prove that at every infinite cardinality, every group which is neither abelian of exponent greater than two nor generalized dicyclic admits a graphical regular representation, settling the infinite-group part of Watkins's conjecture. We also determine the Cayley index of every infinite group: it is $1$, $2$, or $8$, according to its algebraic type, and in every case the index is attained by a connected Cayley graph.
